defs.def: not giving enough attention and thought to what you are doing, so that you make mistakes 不小心的；不仔细的；粗心的

ex.s: B this beautiful countryside is being spoiled by careless visitors C paper and plastic bags are still being thrown away by many tour groups D How can we make visitors more aware of the damage that is being done to the environment?
ex.t: B 这片美丽的乡村正被粗心的游客破坏　C 许多旅游团仍在乱扔纸袋和塑料袋　D 我们如何让游客更多地意识到对环境的破坏？

ex.s: Besides being brilliant, he was brave, though sometimes careless in what he said or did.
ex.t: 除了才华出众，他还很勇敢，尽管有时言行粗心。

ex.s: A ship without an anchor is at the mercy of the waves and winds; likewise, a person who has no sense of responsibility is at the mercy of their own careless and thoughtless behaviour.
ex.t: 没有锚的船任凭风浪摆布；同理，没有责任感的人任凭自己粗心轻率的行为摆布。

defs.def: resulting from a lack of attention and thought 粗心造成的；疏忽引起的
not at all worried about sth 不担忧的；无忧无虑的
not showing interest or effort 淡漠的；不关心的；漫不经心的
